<div align="center">
    <h1>
        Zabbix Synology DiskStation Template by SNMP
    </h1>
    <h4>
        Monitoring Synology DiskStation health and performance via SNMP walk + dependent items
    </h4>
    <br>
</div>
<br>
<br>

<!-- *********************************************************************************************************************************** -->
<!-- *** BODY ************************************************************************************************************************** -->
<!-- *********************************************************************************************************************************** -->
## Description
This template monitors Synology DiskStation via **SNMP** using **master walk items** with dependent items and LLD.
It follows the Synology DiskStation MIB Guide:
https://kb.synology.com/en-nz/DG/Synology_DiskStation_MIB_Guide/

## Requirements
- **Zabbix 7.0 or higher**
- Synology DiskStation with **SNMP enabled** (v2c or v3)
- Zabbix host with **SNMP interface** configured

## Setup
### 1. Enable SNMP on the DiskStation
Open **Control Panel → Terminal & SNMP**, enable SNMP, and set community/credentials.
Ensure SNMP is allowed through the DiskStation firewall.

### 2. Import and link the template
Import [`template_synology_diskstation_7.0.yaml`](./7.0/template_synology_diskstation_7.0.yaml) and link it to the host.

### 3. Set macros (optional)
Adjust thresholds according to your environment.

### Macros used
Defaults include all objects and exclude none. Set the `NOT_MATCHES` macros to a regex to exclude, or tighten `MATCHES` to include only what you want.

| Macro | Description | Default | Example |
|-------|-------------|---------|---------|
| `{$CPU_IDLE_HIGH}` | CPU idle critical threshold (%) | `5` | `3` |
| `{$CPU_IDLE_WARN}` | CPU idle warning threshold (%) | `15` | `10` |
| `{$DISK_UTIL_HIGH}` | Disk utilization critical threshold (%) | `90` | `95` |
| `{$DISK_UTIL_WARN}` | Disk utilization warning threshold (%) | `80` | `85` |
| `{$HRSTORAGE.DESCR.MATCHES}` | LLD include filter for volumes (`{#IFDESCR}` regex) | `.*` | `^/volume` |
| `{$HRSTORAGE.DESCR.NOT_MATCHES}` | LLD exclude filter for volumes (`{#IFDESCR}` regex). Default excludes memory/swap entries and `@appdata`/`@docker` | `^(Physical memory\|Virtual memory\|Cached memory\|Shared memory\|Memory buffers\|Swap space\|Available memory\|Free memory)$\|^/volume[^/]+/@appdata\|^/volume[^/]+/@docker` | `^/volume1/.snapshot` |
| `{$HRSTORAGE.TYPE.MATCHES}` | LLD include filter for storage types (`{#IFTYPE}` regex). Default disabled; prefer `{#IFDESCR}` | `.*` | `^1\.3\.6\.1\.2\.1\.25\.2\.1\.(1\|4\|9\|10)$` |
| `{$HRSTORAGE.TYPE.NOT_MATCHES}` | LLD exclude filter for storage types (`{#IFTYPE}` regex). Default disabled; prefer `{#IFDESCR}` | `^$` | `^1\.3\.6\.1\.2\.1\.25\.2\.1\.(2\|3\|8)$` |
| `{$ICMP_LOSS_WARN}` | ICMP loss warning threshold (%) | `20` | `10` |
| `{$ICMP_RESPONSE_TIME_WARN}` | ICMP response time warning threshold (s) | `0.15` | `0.25` |
| `{$IFNAME.MATCHES}` | LLD include filter for interfaces (`{#IFNAME}` regex) | `.*` | `^(bond\|eth)` |
| `{$IFNAME.NOT_MATCHES}` | LLD exclude filter for interfaces (`{#IFNAME}` regex) | `^$` | `^(lo\|veth)` |
| `{$SYNO_DEVICE.MATCHES}` | LLD include filter for devices (`{#SNMPVALUE}` regex) | `.*` | `^sd` |
| `{$SYNO_DEVICE.NOT_MATCHES}` | LLD exclude filter for devices (`{#SNMPVALUE}` regex) | `^$` | `^nvme` |
| `{$SYNO_DISK_TEMP_WARN}` | Disk temperature warning threshold (C) | `60` | `55` |
| `{$SYNO_TEMP_WARN}` | System temperature warning threshold (C) | `60` | `55` |
